name: Frutiger Aero
summary: Glossy glass buttons, aqua and grass-green gradients, water, sky and bubble imagery and humanist sans type. It grew from Y2K gloss into the Windows Vista, Mac OS X Aqua and Web 2.0 look of the late 2000s.

philosophy.core_thesis: Technology belongs to nature and the human world, so a digital interface should look clean, glossy, alive and pleasant to touch.
design_principles: Build buttons and panels as glass: a vertical gradient, a white highlight on the upper 50% and a 1px light border.
Use a sky-to-grass or aqua-to-green gradient as the main background, with a lightness range of 45% to 95%.
Place nature imagery in the frame: water drops, bubbles, leaves, clouds, lens flares and blue sky at 20% to 60% of the hero area.
Set text in a humanist sans such as Frutiger or Segoe at 14px to 16px, in dark grey or navy, never in pure black.
Add a reflection under hero objects, at 25% opacity and 40% of the object height.
Round every container with a 6px to 12px radius, and use full pill shapes only for primary buttons.
Use soft shadows with 8px to 20px blur and a light glow of 4px to 8px on interactive elements.
anti_patterns: Flat fills with no gradient or highlight
Hard offset shadows and thick black outlines
Distressed texture and torn paper edges
Chrome-silver cyber motifs and pixel fonts
Abstract geometric shapes with no natural reference

layout.grid_mechanics: A 960px centred column on a 12-column grid with 20px gutters; the header, a hero band of 360px to 480px and a row of 3 or 4 glass cards follow in order.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 25% to 40% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 12, 20, 32, 56px and panels have 16px to 24px inner padding.
layout.alignment_rules: Centre the hero and the logo; flush-left the body text inside panels; align cards to column edges and the icon to the first baseline of its label.
layout.container_geometry: Glass panels with a 10px radius, a 1px white border and 16px padding; primary buttons are pills at 999px, and icons sit in 48px rounded squares with a 12px radius.

font_pairings.note: A rounded humanist display over a Frutiger-like text face.
A single humanist family at weights 300, 400 and 700.
A neutral humanist sans close to Segoe UI.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take -0.01em to +0.01em; body stays at 0; small labels take +0.02em.
hierarchy_rules: Use weights 300, 400 and 700, with headlines in light 300 at 36px to 56px.
Set headlines in sentence case and give them a 1px white text shadow at 0 1px 0 on a coloured field.
Use 14px for body, 12px for labels and 24px for panel titles, in dark grey at #1F3A4D.
Make links blue at #0A7BD5 with a 1px underline on hover only.

color.palette_structure: Sky blue and aqua cover 50% of the surface, grass green covers 20%, white glass covers 25% and one orange or yellow accent covers under 5%.
color.contrast_rules: Body text in slate holds 10:1 or better on glass white; white text on aqua or grass holds 3:1 only at 18px bold or larger, so use slate for small text.
color.surface_treatment: Glossy and translucent: vertical gradients from a light tint to a saturated hue, a white highlight over the top 50% and glass panels at 60% to 85% opacity.
color.light_and_shadow: Light comes from the top; each element has a white top highlight, a soft shadow with 8px to 20px blur at 20% to 30% opacity and a reflection under hero objects.

materiality.surface_simulation: Glass, water and polished plastic, as in Windows Vista Aero glass and the Mac OS X Aqua gel button.
materiality.border_rules: 1px solid white at 70% opacity on the outside, and a 1px dark inner edge at 15% opacity; focus uses a 2px ring in deep water blue.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Glass panels use backdrop blur of 8px to 12px; elevation has 3 levels with offsets of 2px, 6px and 12px and blur of 6px, 14px and 28px.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Glossy full-colour icons at 32px, 48px and 64px with a 1px dark outline, a top highlight and a reflection; rounded-square containers.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Photographic and rendered nature: water drops, bubbles, leaves, clouds, sunbeams and fish, set beside friendly figures in bright light.

motion.transition_physics: Smooth and weighty, like glass sliding on a surface: panels fade and slide by 12px to 24px, buttons glow in and the gloss band sweeps across.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover brightens the gradient by 8% and adds a 6px aqua glow; active darkens it by 10%, moves the highlight down by 2px and shrinks the shadow to 2px.

emotion.target_response: Calm optimism: the viewer feels that technology is clean, friendly and close to a sunny natural world.

avoid_when: The brand needs a flat, minimal or monochrome tone.
The interface is data-dense and the gloss would compete with the content.
The platform has a current flat design system that the product must follow.

modifiers.how: Swap the nature imagery for chrome, orbit rings and stars and cool the palette to silver and electric blue; keep the gloss and the pill buttons.
Remove the gradients, highlights, reflections and shadows, keep the sky and grass hues as solid fills and the 8px radius.
Add leather, wood or brushed-metal textures and 2px inner bevels to the controls; keep the humanist type and the top light.
Raise backdrop blur to 20px, drop the gloss band and the reflections and use 25% white panels on a soft colour field; keep the aqua palette.

pack.why: Soft, filled forms with round corners that sit well in a glossy round container.
